title: Personalized therapy of metastatic thyroid cancer: biological characterization and optimization with 124I PET dosimetry
official: Personalized therapy of metastatic thyroid cancer: biological characterization and optimization with 124I PET dosimetry
summary:
Main objective: -investigate if dosimetry-based 131I administration may increase efficacy as compared to that obtained with fixed activity, with an acceptable toxicity in DTC patients with soft tissue and skeletal metastasis:
-study if the mutational status, the gene expression and the variations of miRNA profiles before and after therapy of DTCs may be related to lesions’ refractoriness, even to personalized, 131I therapy

interventions.name: Sodio ioduro (I131) Curium Netherlands 37-7400 MBq capsula rigida

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histo-pathological diagnosis of DTC
2. At least one documented non surgically-curable soft-tissue metastasis previously untreated
3. ECOG performance status = 0 - 1
4. Age ≥ 18 years old
5. Life expectancy > 6 months
6. Females of childbearing age must have negative serum pregnancy test prior to registration and agree to use birth control throughout the study and for 6 months after completion of therapy
7. Preserved hematologic and renal function (hemoglobin > 10 g/dL; WBC > 3500/uL; neutrophilis > 50%; PLT > 100000/uL; albumin ≥ 2.5 g/dL; creatinine ≤ 2 mg/dL)
8. Signed informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. All lesions surgically resectable
2. Assumption of any myelotoxic drugs
3. Previous or concomitant assumption of Amiodarone
4. Any other oncologic disease that required systemic treatment in the last 5 years. Cases who received previous loco-regional therapy on non-target lesions can be included (for example radiotherapy or surgery)
5. Participation in a clinical trial in which an investigational drug was administered within 30 days or 5 half-lives prior to the study drug.
6. Hypersensitivity: history of allergic reactions or hypersensitivity to the active substance, to any of the excipients, to any of the components of the radiolabelled radiopharmaceutical.
7. Minimal lymph neck nodal disease (diameter < 1 cm, up to 2 nodes)
8. Patient with skeletal metastases only
9. Only lung uniformly diffuse miliary micro-metastases without other measurable nodules criteria
10. Ongoing pregnancy (enrollment could be considered after delivery)
11. Breast-feeding (enrollment could be considered after suspension)
12. Refusal of male and female patients to use an effective contraception method during the study and for 6 months after completion of protocol therapy
13. Impossibility to undergo follow-up procedures
14. Presence of medical, psychiatric or surgical condition, not adequately controlled by treatment, which would likely affect subjects’ ability to complete the protocol
